## Deliverables

Clients partnering with AVENIQ receive complete ownership of a production-released mobile application:

- **Complete Cross-Platform Codebase**: Clean, documented React Native repository hosted on client-designated Git infrastructure.
- **Published iOS & Android Applications**: Live app releases published directly to client Apple App Store and Google Play Console developer accounts.
- **Backend API & Database Setup**: Deployed backend API environment (Node.js / Supabase) handling user accounts, notifications, and app data.
- **Push Notification Management Panel**: Administrative console for crafting, scheduling, and sending push notifications to segmented mobile user groups.
- **App Store Optimization (ASO) Package**: Optimized app metadata, descriptive store text, privacy policy documents, and promotional app store screenshots.
- **Documentation & Maintenance Guide**: Technical operational manual detailing build commands, API configurations, and app store deployment procedures.
